issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): The problem statement (UML) declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as a public method (shown as +getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int), but the solution implementation defines it as protected (protected int getTotalNumberOfStudents()). The template file contains a TODO placeholder for this method but no concrete visibility. This visibility mismatch between the UML/problem description and the provided solution may confuse students about the intended API and can cause external code or tests that expect a public method to fail to access it.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method public in the implementation to match the UML and problem description: change the signature to public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() in the solution (and in the template example if an example signature is added). Ensure any tests or documentation that call this method treat it as public. Preserve the existing method body/semantics.
